body.title: Contact Us
body.intro: Questions about our free dot to dot printables for kids? The fastest way to reach us is email: hellokidsbookworld@gmail.com
body.topicsTitle: What we're happy to hear about
body.requests: Tell us a theme your child or class loves and the rough age range — requests genuinely shape what we publish next.
body.corrections: A misnumbered dot, a printing problem, or a translation that reads oddly — report it and we will fix the page.
body.licensing: Personal and classroom printing is already free. For anything beyond that — republishing, bundling, or commercial use — ask first.
body.feedback: What works, what doesn't, what you would like more of.
body.response: This is a small operation, so replies can take a few days. Correction reports get priority.
body.about: More about the site and who makes it: about us.
